# Winnow Wind

Winnow Wind is a quiet background Crystal Earth pony mare from *My Little Pony: Friendship Is Magic*. Think of the pale golden pony with dusty violet hair and a wheat cutie mark among the citizens of the Crystal Empire.

- Appearance: pale yellow coat, muted purple mane and tail, blue-green eyes, and a single golden ear of wheat. See the [Crystal Pony character index](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_ponies/Crystal_Ponies).
- Naming: Winnow Wind is a fandom name, not a verified official name. It likely alludes to winnowing grain; the original naming event is unconfirmed. No alternate identity or official merchandise name was established.
- Speaking status: no known individual dialogue or credited voice actor, as also recorded in the [character list](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_My_Little_Pony_characters).
- Appearances: the G4 television episode The Crystal Empire – Part 2 (2012) and a photograph in the 2016 official recap short Saving the Crystal Empire. No additional film or comic appearance was verified.

## Important moments

- Witnessing the Crystal Heart's return — [The Crystal Empire – Part 2 (S3E2)](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QN9gqykeVHI). She is a background witness to the restoration of the Heart and liberation of her homeland; no individual heroic action is established. Exact video timestamp unavailable.
- Remembering the rescue — [Baby Flurry Heart's Heartfelt Scrapbook: Saving the Crystal Empire (episode 5)](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AtqOoFBROA8). Her photograph preserves her appearance in Pinkie Pie's retrospective of the Empire's rescue. Exact video timestamp unavailable.

## Artwork

Equestria Exploration depicts Winnow Wind with Check Mate in [Familiar Face (gallery entry 45)](https://www.equestriadaily.com/2023/06/newbie-artist-training-grounds-xiii-day_12.html) and with Arctic Lily and Check Mate in [Hope (gallery entry 49)](https://www.equestriadaily.com/2023/07/newbie-artist-training-grounds-xiii-day_6.html). Both are fan art, not show stills. Direct image assets and the original DeviantArt pages could not be independently retrieved, so no unverified image is embedded. The two appearances above are the only documented moments I found, and neither supplies a developed personal story.
